screenSummary.playArea: A battery is connected to an adjustable parallel-plate capacitor. Draggable meters can measure the circuit.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls change battery voltage, plate area and separation, charge and field representations, and meter visibility.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Adjust the battery or capacitor handles, then show and position a meter to investigate the result.

screenSummary.playArea: A battery is connected to an adjustable parallel-plate capacitor containing a movable dielectric slab. Draggable meters can measure the circuit and electric field.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls change the battery, capacitor geometry, dielectric material and charge view, field representations, and meter visibility.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Move the dielectric slab and compare capacitance, charge, energy, and the three electric-field vectors.

screenSummary.playArea: A battery powers the selected series, parallel, or combination circuit. Every capacitor has its own capacitance control, and draggable meters measure the network.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls select one of seven circuits, change capacitor values, show charge and field representations, and choose meters.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Select a circuit and give its capacitors different values to compare total capacitance, stored charge, and energy.
